mapper.select: select pattern, reset_cycle from sys_numbering_rule where rule_cd = #{ruleCd} and use_yn = 'Y'

insert into sys_numbering_seq (comp_cd, rule_cd, period_key, last_no) values (#{compCd}, #{ruleCd}, #{periodKey}, 1) on conflict (comp_cd, rule_cd, period_key) do update set last_no = sys_numbering_seq.last_no + 1, updated_at = now() returning last_no
mapper.insert: insert into sys_numbering_rule (comp_cd, rule_cd, rule_nm, pattern, reset_cycle, created_by, updated_by) values (#{compCd}, #{ruleCd}, #{ruleNm}, #{pattern}, #{resetCycle}, #{actor}, #{actor}) on conflict (comp_cd, rule_cd) do nothing
mapper.update: insert into sys_numbering_rule (comp_cd, rule_cd, rule_nm, pattern, reset_cycle, created_by, updated_by) values (#{compCd}, #{ruleCd}, #{ruleNm}, #{pattern}, #{resetCycle}, #{actor}, #{actor}) on conflict (comp_cd, rule_cd) do update set rule_nm = excluded.rule_nm, pattern = excluded.pattern, reset_cycle = excluded.reset_cycle, row_ver = sys_numbering_rule.row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by
